scope: Current finite CAD-edge motion selects local material cut patches; GPU carries mechanical state
candidate: v11 certified planar charts on non-affine spline fields + front-aligned exact knot insertion
fixtures: loaded partial/full release and exact child state transfer
partial and full cross-cut of the middle fragment
independence of moved and rotated pieces
claims: Geometry-driven topology only: no contact/force/failure-work law, physical tomato, or RL qualification
stop: Stop this representation study on substantive rank/energy/bridge/independence failure. Do not silently add mass, remove particles, soften material or change physical limits. Report unsupported cases explicitly.

integration.observation_side_at_discontinuity: right trace; observations have no point masses
integration.metadata_correction: Copied v06 X-only descriptor corrected to match pre-existing v07 topology.reference_normals. No material, numerical or acceptance limits changed.

gpu_comparison.precision: float64 throughout; no mixed precision or TF32
gpu_comparison.timing: GPU synchronized; separate compilation/preparation/transfer/graph warmup, raw rollout, checked rollout, and CPU comparison. CPU baseline and GPU timing runs sequential. Short repeated timings; report medians and ranges.
gpu_comparison.guard: Retain quadrature and observation J checks every substep, finite-state flags and transactional rollback. Full-cell certificate sampled like CPU reference. No damping/mass lumping/timestep relaxation.

budget_note: New bounded blade-motion topology study; two-hour cap
optimization: One bounded software-only change justified by profile.json: distribute each gradient-transpose force sum across 32 lanes, then deterministically reduce the partial sums.

sweep.edge_definition: Exact centreline of the straight lower CAD perimeter segment: midpoints of vertex pairs (14,15) and (16,17). Full mesh remains unchanged. This marker is not a zero-thickness contact approximation.
sweep.geometry: Only reference-axis-aligned finite rectangular sweeps in an affine-certified connected fragment; reject unsupported/ambiguous cases rather than infer a plane
sweep.ledger: Union of actual swept reference rectangles; no bounding-box fill, no future path and no paid fracture area
sweep.speed_note: Geometry-only fast diagnostic marker speed, not a qualified robot/contact action limit
sweep.physical_force_and_penetration_gates: Retained for later contact; not evaluated by this zero-resistance geometry unit fixture
unsupported: rotating blade during a single action
multiple intersecting unfinished incisions in one fragment
physical blade thickness/contact or paid fracture
sweep.distance_note: Applies to potentially cutting normal advance; degenerate along-edge slides and wholly clear repositioning are geometric queries, not qualified timed robot actions.
sweep.eligibility: Only advance opposite the CAD edge-to-spine direction; withdrawal, held and along-edge slides cannot create new area.

opening_probe.note: Auxiliary material opening after geometry-only cut and full-CAD clearance. Not cutting resistance or fracture work. No artificial position gap.

new_scope.geometry: Automatically certify unique material-reference plane and separable monotone in-plane chart from continuous spline coefficients. Accept nonuniform compression and supported cross-axis bending. Reject curved material cut surfaces and ambiguous/nonseparable charts.
new_scope.front: Insert quadratic knots of multiplicity two at newly visited patch boundaries. Tensor layers span the cross-section, not a fully local 3D adaptive mesh. Preserve old fields by exact knot insertion and verified coefficient recovery.
new_scope.mode_change: Additional local approximation modes change discrete inertia/stiffness spectra; material law, total mass, energy functional and full consistent integration retained. Candidate must requalify.
new_scope.temporal_scope: Start with held non-affine fields and moving fields. Endpoint linear geometry interpolation is not a proof of whole-material continuous contact.
